headline: Elon Musk’s attempt at an AI Wikipedia hasn’t been updated in months
summary: Elon Musk's AI encyclopedia, Grokipedia, is reportedly inactive. It hasn't received updates since April 24th, according to Lawfare. Musk previously touted it as a "massive improvement" over Wikipedia.

headline: X product chief Nikita Bier is leaving after one year
summary: Nikita Bier, X's head of product, is stepping down. He will transition into an advisory role at the company. Bier announced his departure just after his one-year anniversary.

headline: Two of Ring’s latest video doorbells are a lot cheaper than usual
summary: Ring's Wired Doorbell Pro and Battery Doorbell Plus are currently on sale. The Wired Doorbell Pro is $50 off at $199. These models are considered among Ring's most well-rounded options.

headline: Uber CEO brushes off reports of a Waymo break-up
summary: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi denies reports of a strained Waymo partnership. He confirms commitment to continued collaboration in Atlanta and Austin. This follows the end of their joint operations in Phoenix.

headline: 'This Is Not Cool' — BMW Owners Are Annoyed Over a New Spider-Man Ad Forced Into Their Cars
summary: BMW owners are angered by a forced Spider-Man: Brand New Day ad in their cars. The advertisement was pushed to vehicle infotainment systems. Users expressed annoyance over the unskippable in-car content.

headline: The Odyssey Translator Emily Wilson Slams Christopher Nolan’s Understanding of Zeus’ Law
summary: Emily Wilson criticizes Christopher Nolan's film adaptation of The Odyssey again. She specifically targets his interpretation of Zeus's law. Wilson is a renowned scholar and translator of the epic poem.

headline: Google Is Killing Google Assistant on Android Devices Next Month
summary: Google Assistant will be discontinued on Android devices after September 4th. Users previously could revert to Assistant if Gemini failed. This option will no longer be available next month.

headline: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Review So Far
summary: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls shows strong potential in early reviews. The game appears poised to honor the Marvel fighting game legacy. Initial impressions suggest a significant new entry in the genre.

headline: Infantino sorry for errors but stays Fifa president
summary: Gianni Infantino will remain as Fifa president. He received backing from senior executives despite errors. Infantino apologized for his controversial private investment plans.

headline: Ex neo-Nazi activist withdraws as Tory election candidate
summary: Former neo-Nazi activist Joshua Bonehill-Paine withdrew as a Tory candidate. Kemi Badenoch stated he will now advise Conservatives on extremism. This decision sparked internal party debate and public controversy.

headline: University of Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row resigns
summary: Professor Jason Arday resigned from the University of Cambridge. His departure follows a significant plagiarism controversy. Arday stated stepping away was necessary to "bring this chapter to an end".

headline: Jailed funeral boss angers families with 'apology'
summary: Jailed funeral boss Robert Bush issued a controversial apology letter. The letter was addressed to families affected by the Hull funeral scandal. Many families expressed anger and dissatisfaction with Bush's apology.
